title: Brain Note frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the frontmatter block at the head of every Brain Note (~/.claude/brain/Notes/*.md, ~/.claude/brain/People/*.md, etc.). Validator enforces required-by-type rules from entity-types.yaml.

name.description: Human-readable title. Appears in the H1 and in cross-references.

description.description: One-line summary used by Persona.md ## Top Beliefs and by the brain index.

confidence.description: REQUIRED for type=belief. Best-estimate confidence 0.0-1.0. Distinguishes beliefs from world-facts.

sources_count.description: Number of evidence sources backing this note. Auto-incremented when evidence is appended; triggers brain promotion at >=2 for project-memory entries.

freshness.description: fresh=created/updated this week, stable=mature belief, stale=evolved/superseded.

updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Auto-bumped on every write.

source.description: Filesystem path to the Journal entry / project memory / commit / log that backs this note.

quote.description: Verbatim user quote when the evidence is a stated preference.

promote.description: Project-memory only. Set to true to force brain promotion on the next /kaizen:brain promote run.
